target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
make >/dev/null 2>&1   # FAST128 release
echo "=== smoke test: each subcommand exits 0 and writes its CSV ==="
for cmd in "congruence-check --seed 27 --r-max 4" \
           "scan-height --octave-min 10 --octave-max 11 --seeds-per-octave 2000" \
           "tilt-law --octave-min 12 --seeds-per-octave 2000" \
           "defect-windows --seed 123456789 --moduli 27 --tilts 0,1 --char-cap 2" \
           "post-exit --octave-min 14 --seeds-per-octave 2000" \
           "spectral-gaps --moduli 27 --tilts 0 --L 12 --bmax 16 --char-cap 2" \
           "fourier-compare --moduli 27 --char-cap 3 --bmax 18" \
           "trace-det --moduli 27 --tilts 0 --L 4 --bmax 12 --char-cap 1" \
           "shadow-search --octave-min 12 --seeds-per-octave 2000 --moduli 27 --tilts 0,1 --char-cap 2"; do
  set -- $cmd
  ./collatz_tests "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK  $1" || echo "FAIL $1 (exit $?)"
done
echo "=== output files ==="; ls -1 out/*.csv | sed 's#out/##'
